components_rich_editor_addinputrules: A ProseMirror input-rules plugin helper that registers auto-formatting input rules for Filament's rich editor.
components_rich_editor_allowedmarks: A ProseMirror schema helper that computes which marks are allowed at a given content position.
components_rich_editor_atstart: ProseMirror's Selection.atStart() static helper, which returns a selection positioned at the start of the document.
components_rich_editor_ay: A ProseMirror view helper that reads the current DOM selection range.
components_rich_editor_bp: A prosemirror-tables plugin helper used for table cell selection handling.
components_rich_editor_bs: A ProseMirror ResolvedPos-related helper used to navigate node positions, siblings and indices.
components_rich_editor_cd: A ProseMirror command helper that computes a block range used when wrapping content in a new node type.
components_rich_editor_closeextra: A ProseMirror DOMParser helper that closes any extra open nodes when finishing content parsing.
components_rich_editor_closefrontiernode: A ProseMirror content-replacement (Fitter) helper that closes the frontier node while fitting replacement content.
components_rich_editor_compress: A ProseMirror collaborative-editing/history helper that compresses a sequence of steps into a compact rebased set.
components_rich_editor_computewrapping: A ProseMirror schema helper that computes the chain of node wrappers required to satisfy content constraints.
components_rich_editor_cu: A ProseMirror EditorView helper related to focusing the editor and updating its state.
components_rich_editor_cutbyindex: ProseMirror's Fragment.cutByIndex(), which returns a sub-fragment sliced between two child indices.
components_rich_editor_cy: A ProseMirror NodeSelection helper that checks whether a node at a resolved position is selectable.
components_rich_editor_deleteselection: A ProseMirror editing command that deletes the current selection's content.
components_rich_editor_descendants: ProseMirror's Node.descendants(), which iterates over all descendant nodes of a document node.
components_rich_editor_eat: A tokenizer helper that consumes matched input text while parsing, similar to markdown-it style parsers used by ProseMirror input rules.
components_rich_editor_ee: A ProseMirror-related helper function in Filament's rich-editor.js script.
components_rich_editor_enter: A ProseMirror DOMParser helper that enters a new parsing context for a node while converting DOM into a document.
components_rich_editor_ew: A ProseMirror step-mapping helper that validates whether a mapped position or child reference is still valid.
components_rich_editor_f1: A prosemirror-tables helper that joins column-related data.
components_rich_editor_fl: A ProseMirror EditorView helper that dispatches state updates.
components_rich_editor_fr: A ProseMirror content-fitting (Fitter) helper used when computing a replace step.
components_rich_editor_fromreplace: ProseMirror's ReplaceStep.fromReplace() static constructor, which builds a replace step from a transform result.
components_rich_editor_g: A ProseMirror view helper that converts a DOM position into a document position.
components_rich_editor_getstate: ProseMirror's Plugin.getState(), which retrieves a plugin's current state from the editor state.
components_rich_editor_handledrop: A prosemirror-tables drag-and-drop handler used for reordering table rows/columns.
components_rich_editor_i: A prosemirror-tables helper that checks table structure validity.
components_rich_editor_init: ProseMirror's EditorState initialization helper, which creates the initial editor state and content.
components_rich_editor_ir: A ProseMirror DOMSerializer helper that serializes document content into HTML output.
components_rich_editor_is: A ProseMirror Fragment/Node helper that checks and constructs node content.
